create_collision_shapes: create sphere, box, and mesh collision shapes using pybullet createCollisionShape with GEOM_SPHERE, GEOM_BOX, and GEOM_MESH types
create_multibody_obstacles: create static multi-body obstacle segments using pybullet createMultiBody with baseMass=0 and box collision shapes at specified positions
create_jointed_bodies: create multi-body objects with revolute joints using pybullet createMultiBody with linkMasses, linkJointTypes, and linkJointAxis parameters
control_joint_motors: control joint motor velocity using pybullet setJointMotorControl2 with VELOCITY_CONTROL mode and target velocity and force parameters
run_simulation_loop: run a pybullet simulation loop that steps simulation, captures camera images, and reads keyboard events with stepSimulation
